Parliament mein aaj crypto ki awaaz uthi.

Rajya Sabha mein Raghav Chadha ne woh baat boli
jo Indian crypto community saalon se keh rahi hai.

India crypto par
30% tax aur 1% TDS leti hai,
par abhi tak asset class ka status nahi diya.

Clear regulation nahi hai.
Licensing framework nahi hai.
Investor protection weak hai.

Iska result?
₹4.8 lakh crore se zyada capital offshore chala gaya.
FY25 mein 73% crypto trading volume India ke bahar hua.
180+ Indian crypto startups country chhod chuke hain.

Users Indian hain.
Paisa Indian hai.
Par platforms foreign ho gaye hain.

Issue technology ka nahi, policy failure ka hai.

Message simple hai:
Ban mat karo.
Strong regulation lao.
AML tighten karo.
Crypto ecosystem ko India mein hi grow hone do.

Isse innovation, jobs aur tax revenue
sab wapas India aa sakta hai.

Good to see someone raising this with clarity in Parliament.

Crypto ko India mein asset class ka legal status milna chahiye?
